keywords_en: EIP-7932 drops the RLP transaction wrapper and defines its registry
EIP-7928 clarifies BAL gas accounting order
an agent council oracles ERC merged
summary_en: TimBeiko announced Fusaka at slot 13,164,544. SirSpudlington removed the RLP transaction wrapper from EIP-7932 and defined its registry in Python, merged. katzman proposed ERC-8092 to declare, prove and revoke account associations across chains and platforms cryptographically. ameensol mused about privacy protocols where admins cannot rug privacy afterwards but other users jointly can.
